score_tuple.grade: Suspected for every judged score and rank; Confirmed only for the counts this tool computed

T1.title: A score is a tuple, not a number
T1.rule: Store the full tuple with every score and diff tuples before comparing two numbers.

T2.title: Graders are software with bugs and an attack surface
T2.rule: Audit tasks, isolate the grader from the agent environment, and version the grader like code.

T3.title: Grade state, not narrative
T3.rule: Query the system of record for outcomes and keep path checks for hard constraints only.

T4.title: Reliability is a distribution
T4.rule: Report k, variance and the worst-case category, not just a mean.

T5.title: Judge validity comes before judge reliability
T5.rule: Validate against expert labels with kappa and decoys, and pin judge versions.

T6.title: Benchmarks have half-lives
T6.rule: Date every score, schedule re-audits and keep a private slice.

T7.title: The sandbox is part of the system under test
T7.rule: Inventory permitted egress, remove shared writable stores and review containment before running capability evals.

T8.title: Agents optimize the grader they imagine
T8.rule: Check what agents believe about scoring, flag impossible tasks and give agents a safe way to stop.

T9.title: Swarms change the threat model
T9.rule: Evaluate group behavior and peer-instruction authority, not just single agents.

T10.title: Evidence needs provenance
T10.rule: Cite each claim to its evidence tier, state coverage fractions and mark unverified figures.

T11.title: Keep state and context outside the model
T11.rule: Use handles, files and structured notes, and measure tokens per step.

T12.title: Operate evals like production
T12.rule: Run production monitors on internal evals, rehearse paging and enforce policy outside the model.

T13.title: Misbehavior is trained in, not just discovered
T13.rule: Instrument RL runs: probe-rate curves, effort caps on never-solved tasks, and reward gates on boundary crossings.
